subject: MAP close sequence — decision velocity and paperflow coordination
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Liz Carter <liz@elara.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP close sequence — decision velocity and paperflow coordination

Liz / Elara team —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. To make the final MAP and evaluation closure smooth on our side, proposed sequence below: 

1) Elara confirms final pilot metrics and approves the MAP PDF by 7/8.
2) Legal completes redline pass and returns to us by 7/9 EOD.
3) Final go/no-go review with both execs on 7/10 AM (30 min).
4) DocuSign sent for signatures on 7/10 PM with an ask to sign by 7/11 noon PT so we can hit a 7/18 start date.

Attached: Elara_MAP_v3.pdf (proposal + evaluation checkpoints).

As a reminder, from Redwood side: Kimberly will own legal/redline coordination and Steph will own onboarding start logistics.

Can you confirm the approval window and whether procurement needs any additional materials for 7/9?

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
[Attachment: Elara_MAP_v3.pdf (pdf)]

From: Liz Carter <liz@elara.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@elara.com
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP close sequence — decision velocity and paperflow coordination

Aditya —

Thanks for the clear sequence. Procurement has a quick Q on data residency and audit logs — I copied them. We can confirm MAP approval by 7/8; legal will likely push redlines back by 7/9.

Two asks from our side: 
- Can you add a short appendix to the MAP that lists the SOC2 scope and log retention timeframe (30/90/365)?
- If Redwood can commit to a 7/18 start date contingent on signatures by 7/11, call that out in the doc so our PM can plan.

I will coordinate internally and confirm by EOD 7/8.

Best,
Liz Carter
Head of Platform Partnerships | Elara Systems
liz@elara.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: internal: Elara legal redlines and signature window

Aditya / Steph —

Elara legal just sent an initial redline. Key items: indemnity language tightened, data retention clarified (requested 365 days), and a small SLA appendix on uptime metrics. I marked changes that would impact pricing (none material).

I've attached the redline doc. My plan: 
- I will accept non-substantive language fixes (formatting, clarifications) by 7/9 2pm PT.
- For anything material I will escalate to legal counsel; please pre-approve fallback language (we discussed earlier).

Action items for us: 
- Aditya: confirm we add the SOC2 + retention appendix to the MAP PDF and send to Liz.
- Steph: prepare start-of-engagement onboarding checklist to confirm we can ramp on 7/18 if signatures are in by 7/11.

Thanks — I will send the annotated redline back to Liz and procurement once we reconcile the two edits.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redlines_Elara_v1.docx (docx)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Liz Carter <liz@elara.com>, procurement@elara.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Final MAP + go/no-go cadence — request to route DocuSign 7/10

Liz / procurement team —

Thanks Kim for the quick turnaround. Per the redline pass I just uploaded an appendix with SOC2 scope and a 365-day retention statement into the MAP and finalized the SLA clause with our legal. Attached: MAP_final_approved.pdf.

Confirming our proposed timeline: 
- 7/10 9:00 AM PT — 30-min exec go/no-go (Aditya + Liz + their legal lead). Link: https://meet.redwood.com/rdw-elara-gonogo 
- 7/10 5:00 PM PT — DocuSign package sent (Redwood initiates).
- Target signature deadline: 7/11 12:00 PM PT.
- Target first-day onboarding: 7/18 (onboarding checklist will be used by Steph to confirm readiness when signatures clear).

Attachments included: MAP_final_approved.pdf (includes SOC2 appendix). Please confirm you have everything procurement needs. If procurement requires any custom Annex, we need that by 7/9 COB to avoid delaying signatures.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
[Attachment: MAP_final_approved.pdf (pdf)]

From: Liz Carter <liz@elara.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@elara.com
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final MAP + go/no-go cadence — request to route DocuSign 7/10

Aditya —

Confirmed. We ran the exec go/no-go this morning and are green. Procurement approved the SOC2 appendix and retention language. I've signed the DocuSign envelope and asked procurement to countersign — they expect to complete by 11:30 AM PT.

Forwarding the DocuSign receipt here for trail: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/abc123-elara-sign

Start date 7/18 is good from our side; our PM will join the kickoff if onboarding checklist is ready.

Thanks for coordinating fast — see you at kickoff.

Best,
Liz
Head of Platform Partnerships | Elara Systems
